description: A dataset of building surface defects collected by UAVs for machine learning-based detection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Qikai Zha et al. Visual inspection of civil infrastructure has traditionally relied on manual operations, characterized by high labor intensity, low efficiency, and limited scalability, which significantly constrains its effectiveness in modern maintenance and management scenarios. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2025. Formats: TXT, XML, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
